boundaries.name: \Gamma_q
boundaries.description: heat flux segment on bottom edge
boundaries.rationale: Label designed as 1 based on mesh_labels_used [1,2,3] and natural ordering of boundary segments.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_a
boundaries.rationale: Label designed as 2 based on mesh_labels_used [1,2,3] and natural ordering.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: convective boundary on remaining three edges
boundaries.rationale: Label designed as 3 based on mesh_labels_used [1,2,3]; this label groups the remaining three edges.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: dirichlet_value and dirichlet_labels are empty because all boundaries are Neumann or Robin; fe_space P2 preserved from extraction.

expressions.name: k
expressions.rationale: The extracted state weak form uses k; we define k = k_0 as the solid thermal conductivity to complete the model. The provided k_air is retained for reference but not used in the extracted weak form.

characteristic_function.rationale: weak_value taken from extracted spec; represents regularized characteristic function.

optimization_config.rationale: hmin/hmax chosen as 1/100 and 1/10 of unit domain; diffusion 1e-4; v0 0.01; 30 iterations. boundary_labels from design role of Γ_c (label 3); fixed_labels from Γ_q (label 1) and Γ_a (label 2). level_set_initial from extracted initial_level_set.
